protocol.assumed_label_availability: December31 of label harvest year plus1 <= issue date
protocol.failure_policy: abort entire search on any candidate failure/nonfinite output or bound; never select among an incomplete candidate set
protocol.feature_policy: unchanged baseline v2: 90d ending issue minus14d; five calendar years ending Y-3; finite complete static/weather, no imputation; retain zero yields
protocol.holdout_status: public raw labels and eligibility counts inventoried; outer errors not inspected before selection; not externally sealed
protocol.issue_date: December31 of harvest year minus2; not observed sowing
limitations: retrospective static maps and reanalysis; actual historical publication times unknown
administrative maize yield in one country, not farm yield or global accuracy
three outer years and one state partition; no calibrated prediction intervals
published CY-Bench mid-season LOYO tables are a different target and protocol
protocol.outer_outputs: inner-selected best per family and both baselines; overall selection fixed before all outer fits/errors; no post-test promotion
protocol.reuse_selection: same four inner folds per track for all outer years; compute once

rights.terms: USDA NASS public data; upstream card declares CC0

protocol.selection_score: unweighted mean of four inner-year RMSE values in t/ha
protocol.spatial_development: exclude held-out states from all inner train/validation and outer train
protocol.spatial_outer_test: only held-out states in the three outer years
protocol.tie_break: first candidate in declared order on exactly equal mean RMSE
